test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following government official is the ex officio chairman of Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __Vice President.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

__
 
• The post of Vice-President of India is displayed on the lines of American Vice-President. In India, the vice- president has the second-most elevated office in the country.
 
• Article 63 of the Indian Constitution specifies the post of Vice-President.
 
• Jagdeep Dhankhar (As of September 2022) is the current Vice President of India and the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha. 
 
• The Vice–President attends the role of President in his absence (Article 65).
 
• Dr. Sarvpalli Radhakrishanan was the first Vice President of India who served from 1952 till 1962. 

Important Articles related to Vice–President:

 
• Article 66 – Election of Vice–President
 
• Article 69 – Oath to Vice–President and administered by President

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39997ab25e68a0037d9b6e6fc32720c9844f92b075aa45bd0314bdc2cbc8713d.png] Mistake Points__

 
• In the absence of the vice–president, no one attends his duties but the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha acts as the Chairman of Rajya Sabha. 
 
• There is no salary of Vice–President in the Indian constitution but he gets a salary for his term as Ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.
